この会議について聞く

answers.q1: Mostly one surface, but the dark pill-shaped toolbar at the top (pause, chat, expand, more, stop) floats on top of and overlaps the white card rather than sitting inside its header, so it reads as a separate floating control bar stacked over the main panel, not part of the same surface.
answers.q2: Only partly. The title '14:50 の会議' tells me a meeting is being recorded at that time, but there is no meeting name, participant list, or source app/platform shown. The 'AI が見ている資料' line at the bottom implies some material is being referenced but shows no actual document name or content, so I can't tell what specific meeting or source this is.
answers.q3: It is actively recording and listening (録音中 00:02, 聞いています…) but nothing has happened yet — the transcript says 'まだ発話がありません' (no speech yet), and the decisions/action-item sections are both shown as waiting placeholders. It's waiting for someone to start speaking.
answers.q4: The recording indicator with elapsed time (録音中 00:02) and the meeting title (14:50 の会議), since together they confirm the app is live and recording right now.
answers.q5: The floating top toolbar's icons (pause, chat bubble, expand, more-dots, stop) have no labels, so their function isn't obvious at a glance. The meeting title '14:50 の会議' is just a timestamp with no real name, which feels like a placeholder. Most of the screen (transcript panel, decisions, action items) is empty placeholder text, which is expected at the very start but makes the screen feel sparse right now.

weaknesses.what: The dark rounded toolbar at the top overlaps and floats above the white content card with its own shadow, looking like a separate control widget stacked on the surface rather than integrated into it.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the toolbar into the card's own header/chrome, or unify its color/shape language with the card below so it reads as one continuous surface.

weaknesses.what: Nothing identifies which meeting, platform, or people this is — '14:50 の会議' is a generic timestamp title and 'AI が見ている資料' names no actual resource.
weaknesses.fix: Show the real meeting/event name, source app icon, or participant names so the user can confirm the app is attached to the right meeting.

weaknesses.what: At this very first moment almost everything shown is a waiting/placeholder state (transcript, decisions, action items all empty), making the screen feel barren.
weaknesses.fix: Acceptable for a true cold-start, but consider surfacing any known context (calendar title, invited resource) earlier so the screen isn't almost entirely placeholders.
